messages:
Carmen M: FYI — FinTechCo reporting assistant became noticeably more 'clipped' after last night's model push. They say helpful examples and optional clarifications are missing, replies are shorter. Attached 1 example and asked for rollback or pin.
Jordan (support): Thanks. Can you paste the before/after text inline and any request IDs or region info? Also did they pin `model: latest` or a specific model name?
Carmen M: Paste below. Request IDs: r=fin-98765, r=fin-98766. Region: us-west2. They were using `model: latest` from our API. Observed since 2026-03-15 ~03:40 UTC (post-rollout).

--- example ---
Prompt: "Explain bank reconciliation steps for a small business to a non-accountant"
Before (rwd-6.2): "Here are five steps you can follow: 1) Gather bank and ledger statements... (detailed step, example transaction, why it matters) 2) Match deposits and payments... 3) Investigate discrepancies with sample journal entries... 4) Adjust ledger entries, include example adjustment... 5) Reconcile and document recommended checks. If you'd like I can format a checklist or a spreadsheet template."
After (rwd-7.0): "1) Gather statements. 2) Match transactions. Investigate differences. Adjust entries and document."
--- end example ---

Alex W: @Carmen thanks — can you also paste the full request payload (mask keys)? quick Q: temp / max_tokens / system prompt?
Carmen M: Payload: {"model":"rwd-7.0","prompt":"Explain bank reconciliation steps for a small business to a non-accountant","temperature":0.3,"max_tokens":400}. No system prompt. They relied on `model: latest` so got 7.0 after rollout.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: rollout rwd-7.0 -> 100% completed at 2026-03-15T03:38:12Z

Alex W: I ran the same prompt against rwd-6.2 and rwd-7.0 in staging. Quick findings:
Before (rwd-6.2 snippet): "...include example journal entries and a short checklist you can paste into Excel. Consider rounding rules, sample numbers..."
After (rwd-7.0 snippet): "...list steps only. No examples or formatting suggestions."
Looks like 7.0 has a brevity shift — fewer optional clarifications and examples. Not an API error, more of an output-quality/regression.

Jordan (support): Is this likely sampling/decoding config or a training/objective change? Anything changed in tokenization or default sampling at rollout time?
Alex W: Checking logs — rollout notes show a change flagged as "objective adjustment: emphasis on conciseness" (internal flag conciseness_lambda=0.08). That was added to improve brevity on some benchmarks. Seems to have bled into prod for prompts that previously returned examples. Not a decode bug.
Sophia L: Acknowledged. I'll run our eval harness on a set of customer prompts to measure deltas in response length, helpfulness (human-rated), and coverage of optional details. Early hypothesis: objective tweak reduced generated elaborations. Suggest immediate mitigation: revert the model to previous weights for hosted-latest or add a temporary policy to map `latest` -> rwd-6.2 for affected orgs while we assess.
Jordan (support): I'll request rollback for FinTechCo and propose a short-term pin to rwd-6.2. Carmen — does the customer want immediate rollback or to wait for a patch?
Carmen M: Customer wants immediate rollback/pin. They opened ticket #SF-4129 requesting rollback and provided three more prompt examples. Said business workflows were affected (support scripts lost examples).
Alex W: I'll create rollback request and attach repro artifacts (prompt, seed, response_ids). Also saving model evaluation artifacts and a minimal repro script. Will post to #incidents once rollback is scheduled so infra can correlate metrics.
Sophia L: Running A/B now. If we confirm regressions we'll revert the objective tweak in the next patch and re-run the canary with additional human evals. Will update in ~2 hours.
Jordan (support): Thanks team. Carmen — I'll notify customer that rollback scheduled and share ETA after eng confirm.
Carmen M: Thanks — forwarding customer's contact and examples to the rollback ticket now.
